absent: Locking, concurrency and lifetime rules for classifier and scheduler objects.
Packet path entry points, call order and error propagation.
Kernel side validation, defaults and semantic interactions of attributes.
Netlink framing, versioning and compatibility guarantees.
Rate estimation, timing and hardware offload algorithms.

findings.text: Classifier handles use TC_U32_HTID to isolate the table portion while TC_U32_USERHTID exposes a user shifted view and TC_U32_HASH selects the bucket plus TC_U32_NODE selects the entry and TC_U32_KEY selects the low key portion, with TC_U32_UNSPEC marking absence and TC_U32_ROOT marking the root table.

U32 netlink vocabulary uses TCA_U32_CLASSID for class routing while TCA_U32_HASH carries hash info and TCA_U32_SEL carries selector plus TCA_U32_POLICE carries policing plus TCA_U32_ACT carries actions plus TCA_U32_PCNT reports counters plus TCA_U32_MARK reports marks, with additional members for link with divisor plus input device plus flags plus padding, capped by TCA_U32_MAX.

Matching state centers on tc_u32_key pairing mask with value plus offset controls, while tc_u32_sel groups header flags with shift and count plus mask and offset tuning plus hash controls followed by variable keys, and tc_u32_mark triples value with mask and success, plus tc_u32_pcnt pairs run totals with hit totals and per key tallies.

Selector flags use TC_U32_TERMINAL for terminal choice while TC_U32_OFFSET selects fixed offset handling and TC_U32_VAROFFSET selects variable offset handling plus TC_U32_EAT selects consuming behavior, with TC_U32_MAXDEPTH bounding nesting to eight levels.

Route plus firewall plus basic plus cgroup classifiers each provide class with policing plus action and match oriented members and family specific selectors for addresses with devices plus counters plus masks, capped by TCA_ROUTE4_MAX with TCA_FW_MAX plus TCA_BASIC_MAX with TCA_CGROUP_MAX.

Flow keys span source with destination plus protocol with ports plus input interface plus priority plus mark plus conntrack tuples plus class plus user and group plus vlan tag plus receive hash, capped by FLOW_KEY_MAX, with modes distinguishing map from hash and attributes carrying keys with mode plus base class plus shift and arithmetic tweaks plus divisor plus actions plus policing plus matches plus perturb, capped by TCA_FLOW_MAX.

BPF classification carries actions with policing plus class plus program length and bytecode plus file descriptor plus name plus flags plus generic flags plus tag plus identifier, capped by TCA_BPF_MAX, with TCA_BPF_FLAG_ACT_DIRECT enabling direct action mode.

Flower matching covers ethernet with internet version four and six plus transport ports plus vlan and stacked vlan plus encapsulation addresses and ports plus service and lifetime plus conntrack state and labels plus hash plus port ranges plus resolution plus label switching plus control flags plus session identifiers plus fault management plus security index plus hardware count, generally with mask companions, capped by TCA_FLOWER_MAX.

Flower refinements use conntrack lifecycle bits while tunnel option selection is capped by TCA_FLOWER_KEY_ENC_OPTS_MAX and geneve with vxlan plus erspan plus gtp plus pfcp details are capped by TCA_FLOWER_KEY_ENC_OPT_GENEVE_MAX with TCA_FLOWER_KEY_ENC_OPT_VXLAN_MAX plus TCA_FLOWER_KEY_ENC_OPT_ERSPAN_MAX with TCA_FLOWER_KEY_ENC_OPT_GTP_MAX plus TCA_FLOWER_KEY_ENC_OPT_PFCP_MAX, plus stacked labels capped by TCA_FLOWER_KEY_MPLS_OPTS_MAX with TCA_FLOWER_KEY_MPLS_OPT_LSE_MAX plus fragmentation and tunnel bits capped by TCA_FLOWER_KEY_FLAGS_MAX and fault management capped by TCA_FLOWER_KEY_CFM_OPT_MAX with TCA_FLOWER_KEY_CFM_MAX, and TCA_FLOWER_MASK_FLAGS_RANGE selects range matching.

Counter blocks tc_basic_pcnt and tc_matchall_pcnt use 64 bit tallies for runs with hits, where matchall retains only the hit tally, complemented by matchall attributes for class with actions plus flags plus counters plus padding capped by TCA_MATCHALL_MAX.

Extended match state uses tcf_ematch_tree_hdr to record match count with program identity while tcf_ematch_hdr records match identity with kind plus flags plus reserved space, framed by header and list attributes capped by TCA_EMATCH_TREE_MAX.

Match combination uses TCF_EM_REL_END for termination while TCF_EM_REL_AND gives conjunction and TCF_EM_REL_OR gives disjunction plus TCF_EM_INVERT gives negation and TCF_EM_SIMPLE gives chaining, layered by link with network and transport selectors capped by TCF_LAYER_MAX, typed by TCF_EM_CONTAINER through TCF_EM_IPT covering container with compare plus byte with integer plus meta plus text plus vlan plus canid plus ipset plus ipt capped by TCF_EM_MAX, with program typing and equal with greater and less operands.
Relation validity keeps only single bit encodings by masking with TCF_EM_REL_MASK and rejecting via TCF_EM_REL_VALID the case where both low bits are set.

Priorities use TC_PRIO_BESTEFFORT for default while TC_PRIO_FILLER with TC_PRIO_BULK plus TC_PRIO_INTERACTIVE_BULK with TC_PRIO_INTERACTIVE plus TC_PRIO_CONTROL stratify service capped by TC_PRIO_MAX at fifteen, and handles split via TC_H_MAJ_MASK with TC_H_MIN_MASK plus TC_H_MAJ with TC_H_MIN extractors and TC_H_MAKE composition, with TC_H_UNSPEC for absence plus TC_H_ROOT for root plus TC_H_INGRESS aliased by TC_H_CLSACT plus minima TC_H_MIN_PRIORITY with TC_H_MIN_INGRESS and TC_H_MIN_EGRESS.

Telemetry in tc_stats tracks bytes with packets plus drops plus overlimits plus byte and packet rates plus queue length with backlog, smoothed by tc_estimator interval with averaging control, shaped by tc_ratespec cell with linklayer plus overhead plus alignment plus minimum unit with rate, and sized by tc_sizespec cell with size plus alignment plus overhead plus linklayer plus minimum with maximum and table size.

Link handling in tc_link_layer distinguishes unaware with ethernet and atm modes confined by TC_LINKLAYER_MASK to low four bits, sized by TC_RTAB_SIZE at one thousand twenty four, with size table attributes for base with data capped by TCA_STAB_MAX.

Simple queue options use tc_fifo_qopt limit for backlog sizing while tc_skbprio_qopt limit sizes priority id queues and tc_prio_qopt pairs band count with priority mapping plus tc_multiq_qopt pairs band count with maximum, with SKBPRIO_MAX_PRIORITY at sixty four and TCQ_PRIO_BANDS at sixteen with TCQ_MIN_PRIO_BANDS at two.

Plug control in tc_plug_qopt moves from TCQ_PLUG_BUFFER holding packets to TCQ_PLUG_RELEASE_ONE emitting to next plug or TCQ_PLUG_RELEASE_INDEFINITE passing through until next buffer, with TCQ_PLUG_LIMIT resizing the queue.

Shaping uses tc_tbf_qopt rate with peak plus limit plus buffer with maximum unit, while tc_sfq_qopt adds quantum with perturb plus limit plus divisor with flows and tc_sfq_qopt_v1 extends with depth plus headdrop plus dual thresholds with logarithmic controls plus tc_sfqred_stats drop and mark tallies, plus tc_sfq_xstats allotment and tc_red_qopt limit with dual thresholds plus logarithmic and cell controls with flags, plus tc_red_xstats early with limit plus other and marked counts.

Token bucket attributes span parameters with rate tables plus 64 bit rates plus bursts plus padding capped by TCA_TBF_MAX, while random early attributes span parameters with stabilization plus max probability plus flags plus early drop and mark blocks capped by TCA_RED_MAX, flagged by TC_RED_ECN with TC_RED_HARDDROP plus TC_RED_ADAPTATIVE with TC_RED_NODROP, the first three grouped by TC_RED_HISTORIC_FLAGS.
All attribute families start from an unspecified zero member and derive the public maximum as one less than an internal double underscore maximum, keeping numeric values dense as new members append.

Trailing flexible members and nested variable payloads need explicit bounds checks, notably selector keys with per key counters plus geneve option data of variable span plus stacked label entries, while the historic red flag byte is echoed without validation so unknown bits remain userspace owned.

Headers expose the userspace configuration contract for classifiers with schedulers, namely handle encodings plus attribute vocabularies plus option and statistics layouts plus flag sets for netlink exchange.
